run_dreambooth_lora_training: run DreamBooth LoRA fine-tuning on Qwen Image model with instance images and prompts via CLI
create_lora_config: create a LoRA configuration with rank, alpha, dropout, and target modules for transformer layer adaptation
build_dreambooth_dataset: build a DreamBooth dataset from instance images with optional class images for prior preservation loss
save_model_card: save a model card README with gallery images, trigger words, and usage instructions for a trained LoRA
log_validation: run validation inference with the trained LoRA pipeline and log generated images to tensorboard or wandb
